title: Comprehensive analysis of programmed cell death and oridonin target identification in primary lung cancer for prognostic prediction and therapeutic strategies.
authors: Xiang, Xiaoqin; Yu, Xiang; Li, Jing; Cao, Wei; Miao, Rongrong; Zhao, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于TCGA数据构建肺癌预后模型并鉴定冬凌草甲素靶基因，虽含分子对接但核心为预后与免疫分析，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: This study investigated the involvement of Oridonin-related prognostic genes in programmed cell death (PCD) in primary lung cancer and constructed a corresponding prognostic model. Transcriptomic, mutation, and clinical data from the TCGA database, including the TCGA-LUSC (Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma) and TCGA-LUAD (Lung Adenocarcinoma) cohorts with 989 primary lung cancer samples, were analyzed. A total of 38 potential Oridonin-related target genes were identified from the PubChem database, among which 15 demonstrated prognostic significance. Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) revealed correlations between these genes and 13 types of PCD. LASSO and random forest algorithms constructed risk score models and identified FLNC and FOSL1 as independent prognostic biomarkers. Molecular docking analysis confirmed strong binding affinities between FLNC, FOSL1, and Oridonin, suggesting their potential as therapeutic targets. The results showed that the tumor mutation burden (TMB) of the high-risk group was significantly higher than that of the low-risk group. Analysis of immune profiles revealed that the heterogeneity in risk scores was closely linked to distinct patterns of immune cell infiltration and differential activation of immune responses in the tumor microenvironment. Additionally, experimental validation through Western blot demonstrated elevated protein expression of FLNC and FOSL1 in tumor cell lines, and immunohistochemistry (IHC) confirmed their high expression in tumor tissues. The results highlight the critical role of FLNC and FOSL1 as prognostic markers in lung cancer, while also providing new perspectives on the development of Oridonin-based therapeutic interventions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了原发肺癌中Oridonin相关预后基因在程序性细胞死亡（PCD）中的参与情况，并构建了相应的预后模型。分析了来自TCGA数据库的转录组、突变和临床数据，包括TCGA-LUSC（肺鳞状细胞癌）和TCGA-LUAD（肺腺癌）队列，共989例原发肺癌样本。从PubChem数据库中鉴定出38个潜在的Oridonin相关靶基因，其中15个具有预后意义。加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）揭示了这些基因与13种PCD类型之间的相关性。LASSO和随机森林算法构建了风险评分模型，并确定FLNC和FOSL1为独立的预后生物标志物。分子对接分析确认了FLNC、FOSL1与Oridonin之间的强结合亲和力，表明它们具有作为治疗靶点的潜力。结果显示，高风险组的肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）显著高于低风险组。免疫谱分析揭示，风险评分的异质性紧密关联于肿瘤微环境中免疫细胞浸润的不同模式和免疫应答的差异激活。此外，通过Western blot实验验证，肿瘤细胞系中FLNC和FOSL1的蛋白表达升高，免疫组织化学（IHC）进一步确认了它们在肿瘤组织中的高表达。这些结果强调了FLNC和FOSL1作为肺癌预后标志物的关键作用，同时为基于Oridonin的治疗干预开发提供了新视角。
